links.outcome: ROC-AUC from missingness patterns alone, showing leakage inflating performance
links.effect: Diagnostic status perfectly predicted (ROC-AUC = 1.000) from missingness patterns alone; performance fell to mean ROC-AUC ~0.80–0.82 in the most restrictive ascertainment-balanced, age-excluded representation.
links.quote: Diagnostic status was perfectly predicted (ROC-AUC = 1.000) from missingness patterns alone, before any clinical value was examined, and this persisted after semantic harmonization of duplicated source columns.

unlisted_practices: Layered adversarial validation audit for acquisition-bias and workflow leakage in retrospective ML datasets
Label-permutation testing and semi-synthetic ground-truth experiments to validate leakage audits

screen.reason: The study develops and empirically evaluates a layered audit framework (adversarial validation / feature-leakage audit) to detect and mitigate workflow-driven data acquisition bias in retrospective clinical machine learning datasets.

primary.practice: audit framework for diagnostic workflow leakage and acquisition bias
